summary: Three live sparklines for CPU, Memory and Network that shift in a new value every 600 ms.
use: Real-time system or traffic monitors showing the current value beside a rolling mini chart.
spec: `let live = $state({` with `cpu`, `mem` and `net` arrays of 10 values
`setInterval` in `onMount` every `600` ms replaces each array through `next(`
`const metrics = $derived([` maps to labels CPU, Memory, Network
